items.curatedReasonEn: Identifying the optimal method for normalizing peak torque in adolescent athletes helps you more accurately assess muscle strength and function, guiding the design of strength training programs and monitoring rehabilitation progress.
items.limitation: 研究可能未涵盖所有潜在的身体参数和标准化方法，且青少年运动员的样本量和特异性可能限制结果的外推性。

items.title: Exercise-based rehabilitation interventions for kinesiophobia after total knee arthroplasty: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 11 RCTs (N=1,096) found that exercise-based rehabilitation was associated with a reduction in kinesiophobia (SMD = -1.22, 95% CI [-1.72, -0.72]) and improvements in knee function (SMD = 1.19, 95% CI [0.67, 1.71]) at ≤4 weeks after total knee arthroplasty, although the certainty of evidence was low and heterogeneity high (I²=93%).
items.curatedReason: 运动康复仍是全膝关节置换术（TKA）后早期（≤4周）的基石。虽然证据确定性不高且异质性大（I²=93%），但结果提示运动康复能有效降低患者的运动恐惧症（SMD = -1.22）并改善膝关节功能（SMD = 1.19）。这意味着即便有异质性，我们仍应坚持运动处方，并将运动恐惧症作为康复初期的重要干预点。
items.titleZh: 基于运动的康复干预对全膝关节置换术后运动恐惧症的疗效：一项随机对照试验的系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 11 项随机对照试验（N=1,096）的系统综述和荟萃分析显示，基于运动的康复与全膝关节置换术后 ≤4 周内运动恐惧症（SMD = -1.22, 95% CI [-1.72, -0.72]）的降低以及膝关节功能（SMD = 1.19, 95% CI [0.67, 1.71]）的改善相关，但证据确定性较低且异质性高（I²=93%）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Exercise-based rehabilitation remains a cornerstone for early (≤4 weeks) post-TKA recovery. While the certainty of evidence is low and heterogeneity high (I²=93%), the findings suggest exercise significantly reduces kinesiophobia (SMD = -1.22) and improves knee function (SMD = 1.19). This means despite the heterogeneity, continue to prioritize exercise prescriptions and explicitly target kinesiophobia as a critical early intervention.
items.limitation: 研究异质性高（I²=93%），且证据确定性低，部分亚组结果因异质性过大而无法解读，需要更高质量的多中心随机对照试验。
items.limitationEn: The study exhibits high heterogeneity (I²=93%) and low certainty of evidence, with some subgroup results uninterpretable due to extreme heterogeneity, necessitating higher quality multicenter RCTs.

items.title: Midlife mobility assessment from the pocket: agreement and consistency between smartphone placement configurations
items.summary: A study on 46 adults (40-64 years) found strong correlations (rs=0.83-0.93 for balance, r=0.996 for STS repetition count) and good-to-excellent consistency between front-pocket/thigh and lower-back smartphone placements for static balance, sit-to-stand, and Timed Up and Go tests, supporting simplified, potentially unsupervised mobility monitoring.
items.curatedReason: 智能手机放入口袋/大腿位置与标准腰部位置进行平衡、坐站转换和 TUG 测试时，其移动性评估结果表现出良好的一致性。这意味着临床中可以更灵活地使用患者自带的智能手机进行初步的移动性筛查，特别是对于中老年人群，有望简化远程监测流程。
items.titleZh: 智能手机放置位置对中老年人移动性评估一致性的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项对 46 名中老年人（40-64 岁）的研究发现，智能手机放置在前口袋/大腿位置与标准腰部位置进行静态平衡、坐站转换和 TUG 测试时，其移动性评估结果（如平衡、STS 重复次数 r=0.996）具有很强相关性（rs=0.83-0.93）和良好到优秀的一致性，支持简化且可能无需监督的移动性监测。
items.curatedReasonEn: Smartphone placement in the pocket/thigh shows good agreement with standard lower-back placement for mobility assessments (balance, STS, TUG). This allows for more flexible use of personal smartphones in clinical settings for initial mobility screening, particularly in midlife adults, potentially simplifying remote monitoring protocols.
items.limitation: 部分移动性参数在不同放置位置之间存在绝对值差异，提示在量化评估时仍需注意校准或进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: Some mobility parameters showed absolute value differences between placements, suggesting the need for calibration or further validation in quantitative assessments.

items.title: Comparative Effects of Neurostimulation- and Technology-Augmented Robot-Assisted Training on Upper-Limb Motor Recovery After Stroke: A Systematic Review and Network Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A network meta-analysis of 103 trials (5,251 participants) comparing various robot-assisted training (RAT) approaches for post-stroke upper-limb recovery found that rTMS plus RAT yielded the largest improvement on the Fugl-Meyer Assessment for Upper Extremity (FMA-UE) with a mean difference of 9.56 points (95% CI, 7.18-11.93) compared to usual care, followed by LFES plus RAT (MD 7.52 points).
items.curatedReason: 这项网络荟萃分析指出，重复经颅磁刺激 (rTMS) 结合机器人辅助训练（RAT）在卒中后上肢运动功能恢复方面效果最佳，其次是低频电刺激 (LFES) 结合 RAT。这为你的卒中患者上肢康复方案提供了有力的证据分级，特别是考虑整合神经刺激技术时。
items.titleZh: 神经刺激与技术增强型机器人辅助训练对卒中后上肢运动恢复的比较效应：一项系统综述和网络荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项涵盖103项试验（5251名参与者）的系统综述和网络荟萃分析发现，在卒中后上肢运动功能恢复方面，重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）结合机器人辅助训练（RAT）比常规治疗使FMA-UE评分平均提高了9.56分（95% CI, 7.18-11.93），效果优于低频电刺激（LFES）加RAT（平均提高7.52分）和单纯RAT（平均提高3.83分）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This network meta-analysis indicates that repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) combined with robot-assisted training (RAT) is most effective for post-stroke upper-limb motor recovery, followed by low-frequency electrical stimulation (LFES) plus RAT. This provides strong evidence to grade your upper-limb rehabilitation protocols for stroke patients, especially when integrating neurostimulation techniques.
items.limitation: 研究存在实质性异质性，且缺乏头对头比较的证据，导致最佳干预的确定性较低。
items.limitationEn: The study exhibited substantial heterogeneity and sparse head-to-head evidence, leading to low certainty in the definitive hierarchy of interventions.

items.title: Effects of low-dose cervical paraspinal lidocaine injections on cervicogenic dizziness-related outcomes: a randomized, sham-controlled, assessor-blinded trial.
items.summary: In cervicogenic dizziness, low-dose cervical paraspinal intramuscular lidocaine injections (35 mg/session) administered twice weekly for five weeks reduced dizziness-related disability by a between-group difference of -6.78 points (95% CI -8.21 to -5.36) on the Dizziness Handicap Inventory (DHI) compared to sham, which is large in standardized terms but below the 11-point minimal important change.
items.curatedReason: 对于颈源性眩晕，低剂量利多卡因注射液可能在短期内改善与眩晕相关的残疾，但效应量未达到临床最小重要改变。这提示它可作为辅助手段，但不应替代结构化的颈部和前庭康复。
items.titleZh: 低剂量颈旁利多卡因注射对颈源性眩晕相关结局的影响：一项随机、假对照、评估者盲法试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机、假对照、评估者盲法试验显示，对于颈源性眩晕，每周两次低剂量颈旁利多卡因注射（35 mg/次）连续五周，相比假注射，在DHI量表上使眩晕相关残疾改善了-6.78分（95% CI -8.21至-5.36），尽管效应量在标准化后较大，但仍低于11分的临床最小重要改变。
items.curatedReasonEn: For cervicogenic dizziness, low-dose lidocaine injections may modestly improve dizziness-related disability in the short term, though the effect size did not meet the minimal important clinical change. This suggests it may be an adjuvant but not a replacement for structured cervical and vestibular rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 该研究的平均效益低于基于锚点的最小重要临床改变，且未评估受试者盲法是否成功，也没有长期随访数据。
items.limitationEn: The mean benefit remained below the anchor-based minimal important change, and the study did not verify participant blinding or include long-term follow-up.

items.title: Technology Demonstration of a Portable Sensorimotor Assessment System after Short-Duration Spaceflight
items.summary: A portable sensorimotor assessment system, including ankle proprioception and visual-vestibular tests in a VR headset, successfully demonstrated sensitivity to post-flight sensorimotor deconditioning in one astronaut, with decreased left ankle proprioception at R+0 and impaired visual-vestibular parameters post-flight.
items.curatedReason: 该技术演示证明了便携式传感器运动评估系统在短期太空飞行后，能够灵敏地检测宇航员的踝关节本体感觉和视前庭功能障碍。未来这类技术可能应用于特殊环境人群的康复评估，如重返地球后的宇航员或长期卧床患者。
items.titleZh: 短期太空飞行后便携式传感器运动评估系统的技术演示
items.summaryZh: 一项便携式传感器运动评估系统的技术演示成功地显示了其在短期太空飞行后对一名宇航员传感器运动失调的敏感性，表现为R+0时左踝本体感觉下降，以及飞行后视前庭参数受损。
items.curatedReasonEn: This technology demonstration showed that a portable sensorimotor assessment system is sensitive to detecting ankle proprioception and visual-vestibular dysfunction in astronauts after short-duration spaceflight. Such technology may be applied to rehabilitation assessment in special populations, such as astronauts returning to Earth or long-term bedridden patients.
items.limitation: 这是一项针对单一宇航员的技术演示，而非正式的验证性研究，需要进一步的验证和更大的样本量来确定其在临床环境中的普适性。
items.limitationEn: This was a technology demonstration with a single astronaut, not a formal validation study; further validation and larger sample sizes are needed to determine its generalizability in clinical settings.

items.title: Effects of Weighted Seated Core Exercises on Immediate Postural Stability in Healthy Young Adults: An Exploratory Study
items.summary: An exploratory study with 10 healthy young males found that low-load, seated core exercises did not yield immediate improvements in standing balance, and increased TrA thickness during a balance task correlated with heightened postural instability rather than improved balance control.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性研究表明，低负荷坐姿核心练习可能不会立即改善健康年轻人的站立稳定性。在将这类练习应用于康复方案时，切勿夸大其即时平衡效应。
items.titleZh: 加权坐姿核心练习对健康年轻人即时姿势稳定性的影响：一项探索性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对10名健康年轻男性的探索性研究发现，低负荷坐姿核心练习未能立即改善站立稳定性，且在平衡任务中，腹横肌（TrA）厚度增加与姿势不稳加剧而非改善平衡控制相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory study suggests that low-load, seated core exercises may not immediately enhance standing stability in healthy young adults. Avoid overstating immediate balance effects when incorporating such exercises into rehabilitation protocols.
items.limitation: 这是一项初步的探索性研究，样本量小（10名男性），且仅限于健康年轻人群，外推至临床人群时需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This is an exploratory study with a small sample size (10 healthy young males), limiting generalizability to clinical populations.

items.title: Female Team-Sport Athletes’ Physical Fitness and Jump Performance Kinematics After Plyometric Jump Training: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 31 articles (n=609) found that plyometric jump training (PJT) significantly improved countermovement jump height (ES = 0.550, p < 0.001), drop jump reactive strength index (ES = 0.926, p = 0.001), linear sprint speed, and agility sprint speed in adult female team-sport athletes, with longer interventions (≥ 8 weeks) showing greater benefits.
items.curatedReason: 请注意，跳深训练（PJT）确实能显著提升成年女子团队运动员的跳跃高度（ES = 0.550）、下落跳反应强度指数（ES = 0.926）、冲刺速度和敏捷性。为获得更佳效果，你的 PJT 干预方案至少要持续 8 周。这是提高女性运动员爆发力和运动表现的可靠策略。
items.titleZh: 跳深训练后女子团队运动员的体能和跳跃表现运动学：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对 31 篇文章（n=609）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，跳深训练（PJT）显著改善了成年女子团队运动员的下蹲跳高度（ES = 0.550, p < 0.001）、跳深反应强度指数（ES = 0.926, p = 0.001）、直线冲刺速度和敏捷性冲刺速度，其中持续时间更长（≥ 8 周）的干预显示出更大的益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: Be aware that plyometric jump training (PJT) significantly boosts countermovement jump height (ES = 0.550), drop jump reactive strength index (ES = 0.926), linear sprint speed, and agility sprint speed in adult female team-sport athletes. For superior results, ensure your PJT interventions last at least 8 weeks. This is a reliable strategy for enhancing explosive power and athletic performance in female athletes.
items.limitation: 证据确定性被评估为低至中等，部分分析存在中度异质性（I² ≤ 73.1%）。
items.limitationEn: The certainty of evidence was assessed as low to moderate, with moderate heterogeneity (I² ≤ 73.1%) in some analyses.

items.title: Effects of chair-based exercise training on pulmonary function, exercise capacity, and quality of life in patients with acute exacerbation of COPD: A randomised controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=30) found that chair-based exercise training combined with breathing exercises significantly improved functional exercise capacity (mean 6MWD difference: 50.9 m; 95% CI 2.09-99.76; p=0.042), dyspnea, and quality of life in hospitalized patients with acute exacerbations of COPD.
items.curatedReason: 该 RCT 坐实了在 AECOPD 住院期间开展椅上运动训练的可行性和临床效益。它能显著改善患者功能锻炼能力、呼吸困难和生活质量，是一个低门槛、高价值的干预选项。
items.titleZh: 椅上运动训练对急性加重期慢阻肺患者肺功能、运动能力和生活质量的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=30）发现，椅上运动训练结合呼吸练习可显著改善住院急性加重期慢阻肺患者的功能运动能力（6MWD 平均差异：50.9 m；95% CI 2.09-99.76；p=0.042）、呼吸困难和生活质量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT confirms the feasibility and clinical benefits of chair-based exercise training during hospitalization for AECOPD. It significantly improves functional exercise capacity, dyspnea, and quality of life, representing an accessible and high-value intervention option.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小（30 例），可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study's relatively small sample size (n=30) may limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Effects of Functional Inspiratory Muscle Training in Individuals with Obesity: A Randomized Controlled Trial
items.summary: This randomized controlled trial investigates the effects of functional inspiratory muscle training in individuals with obesity, addressing its impact on cardiometabolic, respiratory, and musculoskeletal systems, with the goal of improving lung volumes and reducing breathing workload.
items.curatedReason: 本 RCT 旨在探讨功能性吸气肌训练对肥胖个体心血管代谢、呼吸和肌肉骨骼系统的影响，着眼于改善肺容量和减轻呼吸负担。如果你正在为肥胖患者设计康复方案，这项研究有望支持将呼吸肌训练纳入其中。
items.titleZh: 功能性吸气肌训练对肥胖个体的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 本随机对照试验探讨了功能性吸气肌训练对肥胖个体的影响，旨在改善其心肺、呼吸和肌肉骨骼系统，以期增加肺容量并减轻呼吸负荷。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study evaluated the effects of functional inspiratory muscle training in individuals with obesity, focusing on its potential to improve cardiometabolic, respiratory, and musculoskeletal systems. These findings support the inclusion of respiratory muscle training in rehabilitation programs for obese patients.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Feasibility of an interprofessional rehabilitation program (IPRehab-LBP) for people with chronic low back pain in Ethiopia: an open-label pilot randomized controlled trial with an embedded process evaluation
items.summary: An open-label pilot RCT (n=40) for chronic low back pain in Ethiopia found an interprofessional rehabilitation program (IPRehab-LBP) feasible and acceptable, with high retention (92.5% post-intervention) and outcome-measure completion (>99%), and exploratory clinical outcomes favoring IPRehab-LBP (baseline-adjusted RMDQ mean difference, − 6.29; 95% CI, − 9.69 to − 2.89).
items.curatedReason: 这项针对慢性腰痛（CLBP）的试点 RCT 证实了跨专业康复计划（IPRehab-LBP）在埃塞俄比亚的可行性和可接受性。结果支持将该计划推进到一项更全面的有效性-实施混合试验，为低资源地区 CLBP 管理提供了重要方向。
items.titleZh: 埃塞俄比亚慢性腰痛患者跨专业康复计划（IPRehab-LBP）的可行性：一项开放标签的试点随机对照试验及内嵌过程评估
items.summaryZh: 一项在埃塞俄比亚进行的针对慢性腰痛的开放标签试点随机对照试验（n=40）发现，跨专业康复计划（IPRehab-LBP）具有可行性和可接受性，干预后留存率高（92.5%），结局测量完成率超过 99%。探索性临床结局显示 IPRehab-LBP 组优于常规护理组（基线调整后的 RMDQ 平均差异为 − 6.29；95% CI, − 9.69 至 − 2.89）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot RCT for chronic low back pain (CLBP) confirms the feasibility and acceptability of an interprofessional rehabilitation program (IPRehab-LBP) in Ethiopia. The findings support advancing this program to a more comprehensive hybrid effectiveness-implementation trial, offering an important direction for CLBP management in low-resource settings.
items.limitation: 研究未达到预设的招募率和单次治疗时长要求，且为单中心试点研究。
items.limitationEn: The study did not meet its prespecified recruitment rate and session duration criteria, and it was a single-center pilot study.

items.title: Discriminant and Prognostic Validity of the Multimodal Exertional Test (MET) for Athletes with Concussion
items.summary: This study (n=115 athletes) found that the Multimodal Exertional Test (MET) demonstrated discriminant validity by eliciting greater symptom provocation in concussed athletes compared to healthy athletes. Passing the MET at week 1 post-injury was associated with a 20.6 days faster time to medical clearance (90% CrI = 4.9–36.8 days, pprob > 0 = 97.7%), supporting its prognostic utility.
items.curatedReason: 本研究确立了多模式劳力测试（MET）在评估脑震荡运动员中的判别和预后效度。如果患者能在伤后第一周通过 MET，其医疗清除时间平均缩短 20.6 天，这为您早期管理和重返运动决策提供了有价值的工具。
items.titleZh: 脑震荡运动员多模式劳力测试（MET）的判别和预后效度
items.summaryZh: 这项研究（n=115 名运动员）发现，多模式劳力测试（MET）通过在脑震荡运动员中引发更明显的症状，展现出良好的判别效度。在受伤后第一周通过 MET 与医疗清除时间平均快 20.6 天相关（90% CrI = 4.9–36.8 天，pprob > 0 = 97.7%），支持其预后效用。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study establishes the discriminant and prognostic validity of the Multimodal Exertional Test (MET) in concussed athletes. If patients can pass the MET within the first week post-injury, their medical clearance time is, on average, 20.6 days shorter, providing you with a valuable tool for early management and return-to-sport decisions.
items.limitation: 研究为单中心设计，且受试者为大学校际运动员，可能限制结果向其他人群的外推。
items.limitationEn: The study was conducted at a single academic institution with interuniversity athletes, potentially limiting generalizability to other populations.

items.title: Post-discharge home-based rehabilitation for frail older adults a scoping review of environmental support strategies for functional recovery and aging-in-place
items.summary: A scoping review of 10 studies found that post-discharge home-based rehabilitation for frail older adults primarily involves home rehabilitation, complemented by caregiver support and service coordination. Environmental support components varied, including home assessment, modification, and assistive devices, but their individual contributions remain unclear due to their multicomponent delivery.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述综合了体弱老年人出院后居家康复的环境支持策略，强调居家康复是核心，并辅以照护者支持和服务协调。它揭示了环境支持策略组合的多样性，并呼吁未来研究标准化衰弱定义和结局指标，以更好地评估个体策略的有效性。
items.titleZh: 体弱老年人出院后居家康复的环境支持策略：一项功能康复和居家养老的范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 10 项研究进行的范围综述发现，体弱老年人出院后的居家康复主要包括居家康复、照护者支持和服务协调。环境支持策略的组成多种多样，包括居家评估、改造和辅助设备，但由于其多组件的实施方式，各策略的个体贡献尚不明确。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review synthesizes environmental support strategies for post-discharge home-based rehabilitation in frail older adults, emphasizing home rehabilitation as core, supplemented by caregiver support and service coordination. It reveals the diversity in environmental support combinations and calls for future research to standardize frailty definitions and outcome measures to better evaluate the effectiveness of individual strategies.
items.limitation: 这是一篇范围综述，未对纳入研究进行正式的质量评估。
items.limitationEn: This is a scoping review and did not undertake a formal critical appraisal of study quality.

items.title: Efficacy of real-time feedback exercise therapy in patients following total hip arthroplasty: a pilot cluster-randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A pilot cluster-randomized controlled trial (n=22) found no statistically significant differences in functional outcomes or quality of life between real-time feedback home-exercise and standard written instructions for patients following total hip arthroplasty, though the feedback group reported higher motivation.
items.curatedReason: 本项试点 RCT 发现，THA 术后实时反馈家庭锻炼与标准书面指导在改善功能和生活质量方面无显著差异。提示技术辅助在家康复仍需更多研究支持其优越性。
items.titleZh: 实时反馈运动疗法对全髋关节置换术患者的疗效：一项试点整群随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项对 22 名患者进行的试点整群随机对照试验发现，全髋关节置换术后实时反馈家庭锻炼与标准书面指导在功能和生活质量改善方面无显著差异，但反馈组患者报告了更高的运动动机和自信心。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot RCT found no significant differences between real-time feedback home exercise and standard written instructions in improving function and quality of life after THA. This suggests that technology-assisted home rehabilitation still requires more research to establish its superiority.
items.limitation: 本研究为小样本试点研究（22 例），且主要结局指标未见显著性差异。
items.limitationEn: This was a small-sample pilot study (n=22), and no statistically significant differences were found for the primary outcomes.

items.title: e-health in musculoskeletal primary care physiotherapy: Evidence, facilitators, and barriers - A scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review of 45 studies identified internet-based solutions, mobile applications, and video consultations as common e-Health modalities in primary care musculoskeletal physiotherapy, noting limited evidence for wearables, virtual reality, machine learning, and AI, along with 21 facilitators and 23 barriers to implementation.
items.curatedReason: 这篇范围综述提供了初级肌肉骨骼物理治疗中 e-Health 解决方案的最新图景，它指出了虚拟现实、可穿戴设备和 AI 等领域的证据空白，并概述了实施障碍和促进因素，这对PT 诊所评估和整合数字工具至关重要。
items.titleZh: 肌肉骨骼初级物理治疗中的电子健康：证据、促进因素和障碍——一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 45 项研究的范围综述发现，互联网、移动应用和视频咨询是肌肉骨骼初级物理治疗中常见的电子健康模式，但可穿戴设备、虚拟现实、机器学习和人工智能方面的证据有限，并确定了 21 个促进因素和 23 个实施障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: In primary musculoskeletal physiotherapy, prioritize internet-based solutions, mobile apps, and video consultations, as these have established evidence. For wearables, VR, and AI, evidence is still limited; do not rush to integrate them. The 21 facilitators and 23 barriers identified here can help you strategically plan your digital tool integration.
items.limitation: 这是一篇范围综述，未对纳入研究进行质量评估。
items.limitationEn: This is a scoping review and did not include a formal critical appraisal of study quality.

items.title: From Signal to Biological Meaning: A Systematic Review of Construct-Validity Evidence for External Training Load Metrics in Sport
items.summary: A systematic review of 46 studies found that most external training load (ETL) metrics were supported as descriptions of external movement or work rather than direct indicators of biological demand or response. It highlighted common limitations in hypothesis testing and analysis, with only 28% of studies using a direct construct-matched criterion.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述强调，大多数外部训练负荷指标更多是描述外部运动和工作量，而非直接反映生物学需求或反应。它提醒您在解读这些指标时，必须明确其构造属性、机制和验证证据，避免过度解读为生理负荷。
items.titleZh: 从信号到生物学意义：运动中外部训练负荷指标构造效度证据的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 46 项研究的系统综述发现，大多数外部训练负荷（ETL）指标被支持为外部运动或工作量的描述，而非生物学需求或反应的直接指标。研究指出假设检验和分析中存在的常见局限性，仅有 28% 的研究使用了直接构造匹配的衡量标准。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review emphasizes that most external training load metrics primarily describe external movement and workload, rather than directly reflecting biological demand or response. It reminds you that when interpreting these metrics, it is crucial to clarify their construct properties, mechanisms, and validation evidence, avoiding over-interpretation as physiological load.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的方法学异质性高，且样本量偏小，多数研究仅包含男性运动员。
items.limitationEn: The included studies showed high methodological heterogeneity, small sample sizes, and most studies only included male athletes.

items.title: Lumbar mobility and strength correlate with low back pain and quality of life
items.summary: A retrospective cross-sectional study (n=1309) found that lumbar functional strength (sit-to-stand test) and device-assisted mobility measurements were strongly associated with chronic low back pain (all p ≤ 0.001) and health-related quality of life (SF36-PF and SF36-BP) in both cLBP and nLBP groups.
items.curatedReason: 这项横断面研究坐实了腰椎功能性力量和活动度与慢性腰痛（cLBP）及生活质量密切相关。它支持在脊柱功能评估中采用起坐试验和设备辅助测量，以更全面地评估患者状况，但其预测价值仍需前瞻性研究。
items.titleZh: 腰椎活动度和力量与腰痛及生活质量的相关性
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性横断面研究（n=1309）发现，腰椎功能性力量（起坐试验）和设备辅助的活动度测量与慢性腰痛（所有 p ≤ 0.001）及健康相关生活质量（SF36-PF 和 SF36-BP）在慢性腰痛组和非慢性腰痛组均有强相关性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This cross-sectional study confirms that lumbar functional strength and mobility are strongly associated with chronic low back pain (cLBP) and quality of life. It supports the adoption of sit-to-stand tests and device-assisted measurements for a more comprehensive assessment of spinal function, but its predictive value still requires prospective research.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性横断面研究，不能确定因果关系，且无法评估这些指标对预后的预测能力。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective cross-sectional study, which cannot establish causality and cannot assess the predictive power of these measures on outcomes.

items.title: Effect of Incorporating Perceptual Learning Into Plantar Hardness Discrimination on the Risk of Falling and Muscle Torque in Patients With Hemiplegia: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=34) found that incorporating perceptual learning into plantar hardness discrimination significantly lowered fall risk (ES=1.48), increased knee extensors torque (ES=1.19), and improved FIM scores (ES=1.56) in stroke patients with hemiplegia.
items.curatedReason: 将知觉学习融入足底硬度辨别训练，能显著降低偏瘫患者跌倒风险，提高下肢肌肉扭矩和功能。这项RCT结果明确，提示你可以考虑将此作为卒中康复中感官整合训练的新方向。
items.titleZh: 足底硬度辨别知觉学习对偏瘫患者跌倒风险和肌肉扭矩影响的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=34）发现，在偏瘫卒中患者的康复计划中纳入足底硬度辨别知觉学习，可显著降低跌倒风险（ES=1.48），增加膝伸肌扭矩（ES=1.19），并提高功能独立性评定量表（FIM）得分（ES=1.56）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Integrating perceptual learning into plantar hardness discrimination significantly reduces fall risk and improves lower limb muscle torque and function in stroke patients with hemiplegia. This RCT provides clear evidence that you should consider this as a new direction for sensory integration training in stroke rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 该研究缺乏长期随访数据，且未提及盲法，可能存在观察者偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This study lacks long-term follow-up data and did not mention blinding, which could introduce observer bias.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Comparative effectiveness of different physical therapies for axillary web syndrome after breast cancer surgery: A network meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
items.summary: A network meta-analysis of 14 RCTs (1007 patients) found that soft tissue manual therapy + therapeutic exercise + low-level laser therapy significantly reduced pain (SMD = -4.40, 95% CrI: -5.52 to -3.28) and improved shoulder ROM in axillary web syndrome, while MLD + therapeutic exercise showed the largest improvement in upper-limb disability (MD = -19.01, 95% CrI: -22.52 to -15.52).
items.curatedReason: 这项网络荟萃分析为乳腺癌术后腋网综合征的物理治疗提供了实证基础：手法、运动和低强度激光三联疗法在减轻疼痛和改善活动度方面有显著优势，而徒手淋巴引流结合运动则在改善上肢功能方面效果最佳。你可以依据这些结果优化你的临床方案。
items.titleZh: 不同物理疗法对乳腺癌术后腋网综合征疗效的比较：一项随机对照试验的网络荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对 14 项随机对照试验（1007 名患者）的网络荟萃分析发现，软组织手法治疗 + 治疗性运动 + 低强度激光疗法显著减轻了腋网综合征的疼痛（SMD = -4.40，95% CrI: -5.52 至 -3.28）并改善了肩关节活动度，而徒手淋巴引流 + 治疗性运动对上肢残疾的改善最大（MD = -19.01，95% CrI: -22.52 至 -15.52）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This network meta-analysis provides an evidence base for physical therapy in post-mastectomy axillary web syndrome: a combination of soft tissue manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and low-level laser therapy significantly reduces pain and improves range of motion, while manual lymphatic drainage with exercise is best for upper limb function. You can optimize your clinical protocols based on these findings.
items.limitation: 该网络荟萃分析的证据网络稀疏，且存在临床异质性，部分结果在敏感性分析中可信区间跨越无效值，限制了证据的确定性。
items.limitationEn: The evidence network in this network meta-analysis is sparse, and clinical heterogeneity exists, with some credible intervals crossing null in sensitivity analyses, limiting the certainty of evidence.

items.title: Efficacy of Manual Physiotherapy Techniques for Improving Cervical Range of Motion in Infants With Congenital Muscular Torticollis: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of five RCTs (n=143 infants) found a statistically significant pooled effect (Cohen's d = 0.90, 95% CI: 0.54 to 1.27, p < 0.001) in favor of manual physiotherapy techniques for improving cervical ROM in infants with congenital muscular torticollis, indicating a large overall effect.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述和荟萃分析确证了手法物理治疗技术在改善先天性肌性斜颈婴儿颈椎活动度方面的临床意义。手法治疗应该作为你早期干预这些患儿的一线方案，但同时要注意研究的局限性，期待更多长期数据。
items.titleZh: 手法物理治疗技术在改善先天性肌性斜颈婴儿颈椎活动度方面的疗效：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对五项随机对照试验（n=143 名婴儿）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，手法物理治疗技术在改善先天性肌性斜颈婴儿颈椎活动度方面具有统计学上显著的汇总效应（Cohen's d = 0.90, 95% CI: 0.54 至 1.27, p < 0.001），表明总体效果显著。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review and meta-analysis (5 RCTs, 143 infants) strongly confirms that manual physiotherapy significantly improves cervical ROM in infants with congenital muscular torticollis (Cohen's d = 0.90). Therefore, manual therapy should be your first-line intervention for these infants. However, note the relatively small sample sizes of included studies and anticipate more long-term efficacy data.
items.limitation: 本系统综述和荟萃分析纳入的研究数量较少（5 项 RCT），干预方案存在差异，且缺乏长期随访数据，限制了结论的普遍性和持久性。
items.limitationEn: This systematic review and meta-analysis included a small number of studies (5 RCTs), showed variability in intervention protocols, and lacked long-term follow-up data, limiting the generalizability and durability of the conclusions.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Feasibility, Safety, and Preliminary Effect Estimates of an Ultrasound-Informed Hybrid Joint-Sparing Rehabilitation Strategy in Patients With Rheumatoid Arthritis: A Prospective Non-Randomized Proof-of-Concept Study.
items.summary: A prospective non-randomized proof-of-concept study (n=60) found a 12-week ultrasound-informed hybrid rehabilitation protocol was feasible and safe in rheumatoid arthritis, showing greater pain reduction (ΔVAS: -2.88 ± 0.84 vs. -0.60 ± 0.20 cm; p < 0.001; Cohen's d = 3.74) compared to education, though effects may be overestimated.
items.curatedReason: 这项概念验证研究表明，超声引导的混合康复方案在类风湿关节炎患者中是可行且安全的，并能显著减轻疼痛，但其非随机设计和结果的过高估计需要更严谨的 RCT 验证。
items.titleZh: 超声引导下混合式关节保护康复策略治疗类风湿关节炎患者的可行性、安全性和初步疗效评估：一项前瞻性非随机概念验证研究
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性非随机概念验证研究（n=60）发现，为期 12 周的超声引导混合康复方案对类风湿关节炎患者可行且安全，并显示出比单纯教育更大的疼痛缓解（ΔVAS：-2.88 ± 0.84 vs. -0.60 ± 0.20 cm；p < 0.001；Cohen's d = 3.74），尽管效果可能被高估。
items.curatedReasonEn: This proof-of-concept study shows an ultrasound-informed hybrid rehabilitation protocol is feasible, safe, and significantly reduces pain in RA patients. However, its non-randomized design and likely overestimated effect size call for more rigorous RCT validation.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本、单中心、非随机的概念验证研究，且没有预设可行性标准，可能高估了疼痛缓解效果，且超声指导方案的益处未得到充分证明。
items.limitationEn: This is a small, single-center, non-randomized proof-of-concept study without prespecified feasibility criteria, likely overestimating pain reduction, and the benefit of ultrasound-informed prescription is not fully substantiated.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Walking Capacity and Daily Movement Behaviours After Ischemic Stroke: A Potential Capacity-Performance Gap.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study found that acute and subacute ischemic stroke patients accumulated high sedentary time (~12 hours/day) despite walking speeds approaching community ambulation thresholds, suggesting a capacity-performance gap. Gait speed was the only walking capacity measure associated with daily movement behaviors.
items.curatedReason: 这项横断面研究揭示了卒中患者行走能力与日常活动行为之间可能存在的“能力-表现差距”，即使行走速度接近社区行走阈值，仍有大量久坐时间。这提示你在康复评估中，除了行走测试，还应更关注患者的真实日常活动行为，以指导干预。
items.titleZh: 缺血性卒中后的步行能力和日常活动行为：潜在的能力-表现差距
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面研究发现，急性期和亚急性期缺血性卒中患者即使步行速度接近社区行走阈值，每天仍有约 12 小时的久坐时间，这提示可能存在能力-表现差距。步态速度是唯一与日常活动行为相关的步行能力指标。
items.curatedReasonEn: This cross-sectional study reveals a potential “capacity-performance gap” between walking capacity and daily movement behaviors in stroke patients, showing significant sedentary time even with walking speeds near community ambulation thresholds. This suggests that beyond walking tests, you should pay more attention to patients' real-world daily activity behaviors in rehabilitation assessments to guide interventions.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，样本量较小（n=19+25），不能推断因果关系，且主要依赖客观测量，未能深入探讨能力与表现差距背后的主观因素。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study with a small sample size (n=19+25), unable to infer causality, and primarily relying on objective measurements, thus not exploring subjective factors behind the capacity-performance gap in depth.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Neurorehabilitation as an Opportunity for Structured Post-Stroke Lipid Management: A Narrative Review.
items.summary: A narrative review highlights neurorehabilitation as an opportunity for structured post-stroke lipid management, summarizing evidence for intensive LDL-C reduction in secondary stroke prevention and suggesting integration of medication titration, adherence monitoring, and risk stratification into rehabilitation settings.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述提示，卒中后神经康复可作为结构化脂质管理的机会，强调了密集降脂治疗在二级预防中的重要性，并指出康复环境能促进药物滴定和依从性监测，你可以考虑在你的康复计划中更积极地整合心血管风险管理。
items.titleZh: 神经康复作为卒中后结构化脂质管理的机会：一项叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 一篇叙述性综述强调神经康复是卒中后结构化脂质管理的一个机会，总结了强化低密度脂蛋白胆固醇（LDL-C）降低在卒中二级预防中的证据，并建议将药物滴定、依从性监测和风险分层整合到康复环境中。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review suggests that neurorehabilitation offers an opportunity for structured post-stroke lipid management, highlighting the importance of intensive lipid-lowering therapy in secondary prevention. It points out how the rehabilitation setting can facilitate medication titration and adherence monitoring, prompting you to consider more active integration of cardiovascular risk management into your rehabilitation plans.
items.limitation: 这是一篇叙述性综述，缺乏系统性证据综合，且未包含直接在康复环境中进行药物干预的随机对照试验。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, lacking systematic evidence synthesis, and does not include randomized controlled trials directly involving medication interventions within rehabilitation settings.

items.title: Machine Learning Prediction of Independent Walking 8 Weeks After Rehabilitation in Patients With Stroke: A Retrospective Study.
items.summary: A retrospective study (n=169) compared machine learning models for predicting independent walking 8 weeks post-stroke. The neural network had the highest AUC (0.884; 95% CI, 0.832-0.937) and average precision (0.771), with BBS and SEP severity as leading predictors, though no model was statistically superior after adjustment.
items.curatedReason: 基于回顾性数据，神经网络模型在预测卒中后 8 周独立行走能力方面表现最好，AUC 达 0.884。这提示机器学习在早期预判中有潜力，但鉴于没有模型在统计学上显著优于其他模型，且是回顾性研究，在临床实践中应用前，仍需大规模前瞻性验证。
items.titleZh: 卒中患者康复 8 周后独立行走能力的机器学习预测：一项回顾性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性研究（n=169）比较了机器学习模型在预测卒中患者 8 周后独立行走能力方面的表现。神经网络模型具有最高的 AUC（0.884；95% CI，0.832-0.937）和平均精度（0.771），其中 Biodex 平衡系统和体感诱发电位严重程度是主要预测因子，但经过调整后没有模型在统计学上显示出显著优势。
items.curatedReasonEn: A neural network model performed best in predicting independent walking 8 weeks post-stroke, achieving an AUC of 0.884 based on retrospective data. This suggests potential for machine learning in early prognosis, but given no model was statistically superior and it was a retrospective study, large-scale prospective validation is needed before clinical implementation.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心回顾性研究，缺乏外部验证，可能存在选择偏倚，且预测结果的临床实施仍需进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-center retrospective study lacking external validation, potentially subject to selection bias, and clinical implementation of predictive results requires further validation.

items.title: Beyond Reconstruction: Return to Olympic Medal Performance Following Morphology-Informed and Criterion-Based Nonoperative Management of a Femoral-Sided Sherman Type II ACL Injury - A Case Report.
items.summary: A case report describes an elite field hockey player with a femoral-sided Sherman Type II ACL injury who, through morphology-informed nonoperative management and criterion-based rehabilitation, returned to Olympic silver-medal performance 200 days post-injury, challenging the necessity of reconstruction for similar elite athletes.
items.curatedReason: 这个病例报告展示了精英运动员在股骨侧 II 型 ACL 损伤后，通过形态学指导的非手术管理和基于标准的康复，成功重返奥运水平比赛。这挑战了传统观念，提示在选定患者中，非手术方案结合严格的康复和功能评估可能成为重建术的有效替代。
items.titleZh: 超越重建：股骨侧 Sherman II 型 ACL 损伤后通过形态学指导和基于标准的非手术管理重返奥运奖牌水平表现——病例报告
items.summaryZh: 一项病例报告描述了一名精英曲棍球运动员在股骨侧 Sherman II 型 ACL 损伤后，通过形态学指导的非手术管理和基于标准的康复，在伤后 200 天重返奥运并获得银牌，挑战了类似精英运动员需要重建的传统观念。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case report demonstrates an elite athlete's successful return to Olympic-level competition after a femoral-sided Sherman Type II ACL injury, managed non-operatively with morphology-informed and criterion-based rehabilitation. This challenges conventional wisdom, suggesting that for selected patients, non-operative approaches with rigorous rehabilitation and functional assessment could be a viable alternative to reconstruction.
items.limitation: 这是一个单病例报告，证据级别低，结果不具备广泛推广性，且缺乏对照组验证非手术方案的有效性。
items.limitationEn: This is a single case report with a low level of evidence, and its findings are not broadly generalizable; it also lacks a control group to validate the efficacy of the non-operative approach.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Altered Cognitive Control and Cortical Oscillatory Dynamics in Athletes With ACL Reconstruction During Decision-Making Under Uncertainty.
items.summary: In a controlled laboratory study of 90 open-skill athletes (45 non-ACLR, 45 ACLR), athletes with ACL reconstruction (ACLR) showed slower response times, lower accuracy (d = 0.75-1.09), and persistent alterations in cortical oscillatory mechanisms related to cognitive control, motor preparation, and attentional allocation during decision-making under uncertainty.
items.curatedReason: 这项对照实验室研究明确指出，ACL重建运动员在不确定决策情境中表现出持续的认知控制和皮层振荡动态改变，提示标准评估可能未能检测到的中枢神经系统重构。这直接支持将神经认知评估整合到重返运动协议中，以降低再损伤风险。
items.titleZh: ACL重建运动员在不确定决策中认知控制和皮层振荡动态的改变
items.summaryZh: 一项对90名开放技能运动员（45名非ACLR，45名ACLR）进行的对照实验室研究显示，ACLR运动员在不确定决策中表现出较慢的反应时间、较低的准确性（d = 0.75-1.09），以及与认知控制、运动准备和注意力分配相关的皮层振荡机制持续改变。
items.curatedReasonEn: This controlled laboratory study clearly indicates that ACLR athletes exhibit persistent alterations in cognitive control and cortical oscillatory dynamics during uncertain decision-making, suggesting central nervous system reorganization not detected by standard assessments. This directly supports integrating neurocognitive assessment into return-to-sport protocols to reduce reinjury risk.
items.limitation: 本研究为实验室环境下的对照研究，结果可能无法完全推广到真实的运动场景。
items.limitationEn: This controlled study was conducted in a laboratory setting, and the findings may not be fully generalizable to real-world sports contexts.
items.journal: The American journal of sports medicine

items.title: Diagnosis, Rehabilitation, and Return to Sport after Athletic Hamstring Injury: An ICCUS Society Consensus Statement.
items.summary: An ICCUS Society consensus statement, derived from a modified Delphi process with 17 expert clinicians, achieved over 80% agreement on 54 statements across three domains for managing athletic hamstring injuries, emphasizing standardized terminology, individualized criterion-based rehabilitation, progressive tissue loading, and objective assessment for return-to-sport decisions.
items.curatedReason: 这份ICCUS Society的专家共识声明为运动性腘绳肌损伤的分类、康复和重返运动提供了统一框架。它强调了标准化的术语、个体化的康复、渐进式负荷、客观力量评估和运动员准备度，这些都是你设计和管理此类损伤的关键依据。
items.titleZh: 运动性腘绳肌损伤的诊断、康复和重返运动：ICCUS学会共识声明
items.summaryZh: 一份ICCUS学会共识声明，由17位专家临床医生通过修改后的德尔菲法得出，在运动性腘绳肌损伤管理的三大领域中，有54项声明获得了超过80%的同意，强调了标准化术语、个体化基于标准的康复、渐进式组织负荷以及重返运动决策的客观评估。
items.curatedReasonEn: This ICCUS Society expert consensus statement provides a unified framework for the classification, rehabilitation, and return to sport after athletic hamstring injuries. It emphasizes standardized terminology, individualized rehabilitation, progressive loading, objective strength assessment, and athlete readiness, which are crucial for you in designing and managing such injuries.
items.limitation: 本研究通过Delphi法达成共识，结果反映了专家组的集体意见，但并非基于随机对照试验的直接证据。
items.limitationEn: This study achieved consensus via the Delphi method, reflecting the expert panel's collective opinion rather than direct evidence from randomized controlled trials.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Neurocognitive Factors in ACL Injury: The Missing Piece in Rehabilitation and Prevention? A Scoping Review.
items.summary: A scoping review of 42 studies suggests that neurocognitive factors, including dual-task interference, visual attention, reaction time, and cognitive fatigue, are significant contributors to ACL injury and that integrating neurocognitive challenges into rehabilitation and RTS testing may help identify athletes at risk for secondary injury.
items.curatedReason: 这篇范围综述指出，神经认知因素可能是当前ACL康复和预防框架中缺失的重要组成部分。它提示你，将神经认知挑战整合到康复和重返运动测试中，可能更好地识别二次损伤风险高的运动员。
items.titleZh: ACL损伤中的神经认知因素：康复和预防中缺失的一环？一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项包含42项研究的范围综述表明，神经认知因素，包括双任务干扰、视觉注意、反应时间和认知疲劳，是ACL损伤的重要影响因素，将神经认知挑战整合到康复和重返运动测试中可能有助于识别有二次损伤风险的运动员。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review suggests that neurocognitive factors may be a critical missing component in current ACL rehabilitation and prevention frameworks. It indicates that integrating neurocognitive challenges into rehabilitation and return-to-sport testing might better identify athletes at high risk for secondary injury.
items.limitation: 当前证据主要来源于实验室和探索性研究，缺乏前瞻性和临床转化数据，因此神经认知干预在实践中的有效性仍需更多研究支持。
items.limitationEn: Current evidence is predominantly derived from laboratory-based and exploratory studies, lacking prospective and clinically translational data, thus requiring more research to support the practical efficacy of neurocognitive interventions.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Healthcare professionals' perceptions and experiences of promoting physical activity in persons with multiple sclerosis: a systematic review of qualitative evidence.
items.summary: A systematic review of eight studies found that improving physical activity promotion in MS care requires MS-specific education and training for healthcare professionals, practical resources such as patient education materials and referral pathways, and stronger cross-sector coordination to sustain consistent practice.
items.curatedReason: 这份系统综述强调，提高MS患者的运动促进效果，需要针对性的教育培训、患者教育材料、转诊路径以及跨部门协作。这对PT设计MS康复项目有直接的指导意义，特别是针对如何提升患者依从性和促进运动参与。
items.titleZh: 医护人员对多发性硬化症患者运动促进的看法和经验：一项定性证据系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项包含8项研究的系统综述发现，为改善多发性硬化症患者的运动促进，需加强医护人员的MS特异性教育与培训、提供患者教育材料和转诊路径等实用资源，并强化跨部门协调以维持持续实践。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review highlights that effective physical activity promotion in MS patients requires targeted education, patient materials, referral pathways, and cross-sector coordination. This offers direct guidance for PTs in designing MS rehabilitation programs, particularly for improving patient adherence and exercise participation.
items.limitation: 纳入研究均为定性证据，其结果受限于医疗专业人员的感知和经验，不直接评估干预措施的临床疗效。
items.limitationEn: The included studies are qualitative, with results limited by healthcare professionals' perceptions and experiences, and do not directly evaluate the clinical efficacy of interventions.

items.title: Adherence System Usability Patient Experience and Psychosocial Impact in Robot Assisted Gait Neurorehabilitation A Cross Sectional Study.
items.summary: A single-center observational study of 250 adults in robot-assisted gait neurorehabilitation found that greater attendance, usability, and rehabilitation experience were associated with a favorable psychosocial impact, with mean participation at 86.35% ± 8.38% and strong correlations (r s = 0.41 to 0.53) between adherence, system usability, rehabilitation experience, and psychosocial impact.
items.curatedReason: 这项横断面研究提示，机器人辅助步态神经康复中的依从性、可用性和康复体验，与患者的心理社会影响呈正相关。临床上应重视患者对机器人设备的体验，以提升整体康复效果。
items.titleZh: 机器人辅助步态神经康复中依从性系统可用性患者体验及心理社会影响：一项横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对250名接受机器人辅助步态神经康复的成年人的单中心观察研究发现，更高的出勤率、可用性和康复体验与积极的心理社会影响相关，平均参与率为86.35%±8.38%，依从性、系统可用性、康复经验和心理社会影响之间存在强相关性（rs = 0.41至0.53）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This cross-sectional study suggests that adherence, usability, and rehabilitation experience in robot-assisted gait neurorehabilitation are positively associated with patients' psychosocial impact. Clinicians should prioritize patients' experiences with robotic devices to enhance overall rehabilitation outcomes.
items.limitation: 横断面研究设计无法确立因果关系，且患者诊断异质性、问卷同步评估以及与出勤的时间不匹配限制了结果的解释。
items.limitationEn: The cross-sectional study design prevents establishing causality, and diagnostic heterogeneity, simultaneous questionnaire assessment, and temporal mismatch with attendance limit interpretation.

items.title: Gamified Versus Traditional Balance Training: Effects on Balance and Motivation in Collegiate Student-Athletes.
items.summary: A quasi-experimental controlled trial of 30 collegiate athletes found that both gamified (Wii Fit) and traditional (wobble board) balance training significantly improved anterior reach and mSEBT composite scores compared to control (gamified: +21.6 ± 11.9 cm; traditional: +18.5 ± 14.6 cm; p < 0.01), with gamified training eliciting higher interest/enjoyment scores (5.0 ± 1.2 vs 3.2 ± 1.3; p < 0.01).
items.curatedReason: 这项准实验研究表明，游戏化平衡训练在改善大学运动员动态平衡方面与传统训练效果相似，且能带来更高的乐趣。你可以考虑将游戏化平台作为一种有吸引力的选择，用于运动员的平衡康复和损伤预防计划。
items.titleZh: 游戏化与传统平衡训练：对大学学生运动员平衡和动机的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项针对30名大学生运动员的准实验对照试验发现，游戏化（Wii Fit）和传统（摇摆板）平衡训练均显著改善了前向伸展和mSEBT综合评分（游戏化：+21.6 ± 11.9 cm；传统：+18.5 ± 14.6 cm；p < 0.01），游戏化训练带来了更高的兴趣/乐趣评分（5.0 ± 1.2 vs 3.2 ± 1.3；p < 0.01）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This quasi-experimental study indicates that gamified balance training yields similar improvements in dynamic balance for collegiate athletes as traditional training, while also increasing enjoyment. You might consider incorporating gamified platforms as an engaging option for athletes' balance rehabilitation and injury prevention programs.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本的准实验研究，结果的普适性受限，且参与者伪随机分组可能引入选择偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This is a small-sample quasi-experimental study with limited generalizability, and pseudo-randomization of participants may introduce selection bias.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Ultrasound-Guided Percutaneous Tendon Dry Needling for Recalcitrant Distal Biceps Tendinopathy: A Case Series.
items.summary: A case series of two recreationally active adults with chronic distal biceps tendinopathy showed that ultrasound-guided percutaneous tendon dry needling, combined with a graded loading program, contributed to reduced pain and disability at 6 months, with both subjects exceeding the minimal clinically important difference for outcome measures.
items.curatedReason: 本病例系列提示超声引导下干针联合负重训练，可能有助于改善远端肱二头肌肌腱病患者的疼痛和功能。这对难治性病例提供了一个潜在的治疗选项。
items.titleZh: 超声引导经皮肌腱干针治疗难治性远端肱二头肌肌腱病：一个病例系列
items.summaryZh: 一项针对两名慢性远端肱二头肌肌腱病成年患者的病例系列研究显示，超声引导经皮肌腱干针结合分级负重训练，在6个月时有助于减轻疼痛和残疾，两名受试者的结局测量均超出了最小临床重要差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case series suggests that ultrasound-guided dry needling combined with a graded loading program may help reduce pain and improve function in patients with recalcitrant distal biceps tendinopathy, offering a potential treatment option for difficult cases.
items.limitation: 本研究为小样本病例系列，证据等级较低，无法支持超声引导干针的普遍有效性或因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This study is a small case series with a low level of evidence, precluding generalization of the findings or establishment of causality for ultrasound-guided dry needling.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: What are the barriers and facilitators to engagement with physiotherapy among women experiencing adverse effects associated with menopause?
items.summary: A qualitative study identified fatigue, cognitive issues, and low self-efficacy as barriers to physiotherapy engagement among 12 menopausal women with musculoskeletal pain in the UK. Facilitators included direct inquiry about menopause, feeling heard, individualized treatment, and education.
items.curatedReason: 本项定性研究提示，询问更年期相关症状、提供个体化治疗方案和健康教育，能提高更年期女性肌肉骨骼疼痛患者的物理治疗依从性。这提醒你除了关注疼痛本身，还要留意更年期综合征对患者依从性的潜在影响。
items.titleZh: 更年期女性肌肉骨骼疼痛患者参与物理治疗的障碍与促进因素
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究发现，在英国12名伴有肌肉骨骼疼痛的更年期女性中，疲劳、认知问题和低自我效能是参与物理治疗的障碍。而直接询问更年期症状、被倾听、个体化治疗和健康教育是促进因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study suggests that inquiring about menopause-related symptoms, offering individualized treatment plans, and providing education can improve adherence to physiotherapy among women with menopausal musculoskeletal pain. This highlights the importance of considering menopause's potential impact on patient adherence, beyond focusing solely on pain.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小且局限于英国单一NHS机构，结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study has a small sample size and is limited to a single NHS institution in the UK, thus its generalizability is limited.

items.title: Effects of Medium-frequency Electrical Stimulation Combined with Near-Infrared Light on Quadriceps Function and Independent Walking in Patients with Spinal Cord Injury.
items.summary: A two-phase study (n=36 SCI, n=15 healthy controls, then n=18 SCI) found SCI patients had reduced quadriceps electromyographic activity and impaired deep femoral artery hemodynamics. Combined medium-frequency electrical stimulation and near-infrared therapy showed within-group improvements across all assessed outcomes, with significant inter-group differences in right peak systolic velocity and walking ability.
items.curatedReason: 初步证据表明，中频电刺激结合近红外光可能改善脊髓损伤患者的股四头肌激活、股动脉血流速度和步行能力。在考虑使用新型辅助疗法时，请关注这项初步发现，但目前尚不足以改变常规临床实践。
items.titleZh: 中频电刺激联合近红外光对脊髓损伤患者股四头肌功能和独立行走能力的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项两阶段研究（n=36名脊髓损伤患者，n=15名健康对照；第二阶段n=18名脊髓损伤患者）发现，脊髓损伤患者股四头肌肌电活动减少，股深动脉血流动力学受损。中频电刺激联合近红外疗法在治疗组内所有评估结果均有改善，右侧收缩期峰值速度和步行能力在组间存在显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Preliminary evidence suggests that medium-frequency electrical stimulation combined with near-infrared light may improve quadriceps activation, femoral artery blood flow velocity, and walking ability in patients with spinal cord injury. Keep this preliminary finding in mind when considering novel adjunctive therapies, but it is not yet sufficient to change routine clinical practice.
items.limitation: 本研究第二阶段为非随机对照设计，样本量小，且只关注了股四头肌，结果需通过更大规模的随机研究进一步确认。
items.limitationEn: Phase II of this study was a nonrandomized controlled design with a small sample size and focused only on quadriceps, requiring confirmation in larger, randomized studies.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Development of a Single-Camera Markerless Motion Capture System for Assessing Upper Limb Function Post-Stroke (FULMA).
items.summary: The Functional Upper Limb Movement Assessment (FULMA) system, a single-camera markerless motion capture tool, achieved 83.3% mean accuracy (weighted kappa 0.67-0.88) in predicting ordinal task performance scores for upper limb function in 39 stroke participants and 19 healthy controls, showing preliminary agreement with occupational therapist ratings.
items.curatedReason: FULMA 系统显示了单摄像头无标记运动捕捉在卒中后上肢功能评估方面的初步潜力，其预测分数与治疗师评估具有较好的一致性。未来该系统若能通过外部验证和测量属性评估，有望成为客观监测患者康复进展的工具，辅助你进行量化评估。
items.titleZh: 用于评估卒中后上肢功能的单摄像头无标记运动捕捉系统（FULMA）的开发
items.summaryZh: 功能性上肢运动评估系统 (FULMA)，一款单摄像头无标记运动捕捉工具，在39名卒中患者和19名健康对照中，预测上肢功能序数任务表现分数达到了83.3%的平均准确率（加权Kappa 0.67-0.88），显示出与职业治疗师评估的初步一致性。
items.curatedReasonEn: The FULMA system shows preliminary potential for single-camera markerless motion capture in assessing upper limb function post-stroke, with good agreement between predicted scores and therapist ratings. If externally validated and evaluated for measurement properties, this system could become a valuable tool for objectively monitoring patient rehabilitation progress, aiding in quantitative assessment.
items.limitation: 本研究为开发性观察研究，在受控数据集上进行了初步验证，尚需外部验证和测量属性评估才能用于临床。
items.limitationEn: This is a developmental observational study with preliminary validation on a controlled dataset; external validation and evaluation of measurement properties are needed before clinical use.

items.title: Conservative and Post-Operative Rehabilitation Protocols for Hip Dysplasia in Adolescents to Adulthood: A Literature Review.
items.summary: A literature review of 12 sources on hip dysplasia (DDH) rehabilitation in adolescents and adults (13-50 years) found physiotherapy to be a central component, emphasizing hip abductor, extensor, external rotator strengthening, lumbopelvic stability, and movement pattern retraining. Post-operative protocols applied phased, criterion-based progressions.
items.curatedReason: 这项综述表明，物理治疗是青少年和成人髋关节发育不良（DDH）保守和术后康复的核心组成部分，多模式、基于标准的渐进性强化和神经肌肉再训练是主要方法。这强化了你作为物理治疗师在DDH管理中的关键作用，并提示应根据患者进展而非时间来推进康复。
items.titleZh: 青少年至成年期髋关节发育不良的保守治疗和术后康复方案：文献综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对12篇关于青少年和成人（13-50岁）髋关节发育不良（DDH）康复文献的综述发现，物理治疗是核心组成部分，强调髋外展肌、伸肌、外旋肌强化，腰盆稳定性及运动模式再训练。术后方案采用分阶段、基于标准的渐进性康复。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review indicates that physiotherapy is a central component of both conservative and post-operative rehabilitation for adolescents and adults with developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH), with multimodal, criterion-based progressive strengthening and neuromuscular retraining as primary approaches. This reinforces your critical role as a physical therapist in DDH management and suggests rehabilitation progression should be guided by patient progress rather than time.
items.limitation: 现有证据质量受方法学异质性、样本量小和依赖专家共识的限制，缺乏高质量的比较试验。
items.limitationEn: The current evidence quality is limited by methodological heterogeneity, small sample sizes, and reliance on expert consensus, lacking high-quality comparative trials.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Interactive Gardening Intervention for Preschoolers With Developmental Delays: A Family-Centered Feasibility Study.
items.summary: A nonrandomized controlled pilot study (n=60 caregiver-child dyads) found a 6-week interactive gardening intervention improved social functioning (mean change, 3.34 ± 9.47; p = .007) within the intervention group of preschoolers with developmental delays, compared to controls (1.72 ± 13.56; p = .269). No significant changes were seen in sensory integration or caregiver outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步观察研究提示，为期6周的家庭互动式园艺活动可能改善发育迟缓学龄前儿童的社交功能。虽然是小样本非随机研究，但为强调家庭参与和社交互动的早期康复提供了一个可尝试的补充干预思路。
items.titleZh: 互动式园艺干预对发育迟缓学龄前儿童的影响：一项以家庭为中心的可行性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项非随机对照试点研究（n=60对照顾者-儿童配对）发现，为期6周的互动式园艺干预改善了发育迟缓学龄前儿童干预组内的社交功能（平均变化3.34 ± 9.47；p = .007），而对照组无显著改善（1.72 ± 13.56；p = .269）。感官整合或照顾者相关结局未见显著变化。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preliminary observational study suggests that a 6-week home-based interactive gardening intervention might improve social functioning in preschoolers with developmental delays. While a small, non-randomized study, it offers a potential supplementary intervention idea for early rehabilitation emphasizing family involvement and social interaction.
items.limitation: 本研究为非随机对照的试点研究，样本量相对较小，且社交功能改善仅为组内显著，缺乏对感官整合和照护者结局的显著影响。
items.limitationEn: This is a nonrandomized controlled pilot study with a relatively small sample size, showing only within-group significant improvement in social functioning and lacking significant effects on sensory integration and caregiver outcomes.

items.title: Cardiorespiratory training after stroke or transient ischemic attack in the United Kingdom: A national survey.
items.summary: A national UK survey (n=253 physiotherapists and exercise professionals) revealed variable provision of cardiorespiratory training after stroke or TIA. Concerns included serious adverse events, fatigue, and falls, while barriers were service commissioning, resources, skills/knowledge, and lack of guidelines. People with greater disability may be less likely to receive this training.
items.curatedReason: 这项英国全国调查提醒我们，卒中或TIA后心肺训练的实践仍面临诸多障碍。你需要特别关注的是，残疾程度较高的患者可能更少获得此类训练，而服务资源、专业知识和指南的缺乏是主要症结。这促使我们反思并呼吁改进服务公平性及资源配置。
items.titleZh: 英国卒中或短暂性脑缺血发作后的心肺训练：一项全国调查
items.summaryZh: 一项英国全国性调查（n=253名物理治疗师和运动专业人士）显示，卒中或短暂性脑缺血发作（TIA）后的心肺训练服务提供情况各异。主要担忧包括严重不良事件、疲劳和跌倒，而障碍则涉及服务委托、资源、技能/知识和缺乏指南。重度残疾患者可能更难获得此项训练。
items.curatedReasonEn: This UK national survey highlights that cardiorespiratory training after stroke or TIA still faces numerous barriers. You should particularly note that individuals with greater disability may be less likely to receive this training, with service commissioning, resources, knowledge, and lack of guidelines identified as key issues. This prompts us to reflect on and advocate for improved service equity and resource allocation.
items.limitation: 本研究为在线调查，可能存在报告偏差，且未能全面反映所有地区的实践情况。
items.limitationEn: This online survey may have reporting bias and may not fully reflect practices in all regions.

items.title: Comparative study of therapeutic ultrasound and whole-body vibration as adjuncts to passive stretching on knee joint range of motion and functional ability in children with hemiplegic cerebral palsy: a randomized trial
items.summary: A randomized trial with 60 children (4-6 years old) with hemiplegic cerebral palsy found that whole-body vibration (WBV) as an adjunct to passive stretching resulted in significantly greater improvements in active knee extension ROM (13.82% vs 7.05%) and Gross Motor Function Measure-88 scores (22.72% vs 11.32%) over 12 weeks compared to therapeutic ultrasound.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 明确了全身振动训练（WBV）作为被动牵伸的辅助手段，在改善脑瘫儿童膝关节活动度和粗大运动功能方面优于治疗性超声。对儿科物理治疗师而言，WBV 可能提供更有效的干预方案来解决痉挛和运动限制。
items.titleZh: 治疗性超声与全身振动作为被动牵伸辅助手段对偏瘫脑瘫儿童膝关节活动度和功能能力影响的比较研究：一项随机试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对60名4-6岁偏瘫脑瘫儿童的随机试验发现，全身振动（WBV）作为被动牵伸的辅助手段，在12周后显著改善了主动膝关节伸展活动度（13.82% vs 7.05%）和粗大运动功能量表-88分数（22.72% vs 11.32%），效果优于治疗性超声。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT clearly demonstrates that whole-body vibration (WBV) as an adjunct to passive stretching is superior to therapeutic ultrasound in improving knee joint range of motion and gross motor function in children with cerebral palsy. For pediatric physical therapists, WBV may offer a more effective intervention for addressing spasticity and motor limitations.
items.limitation: 研究仅限于4-6岁半偏瘫脑瘫儿童，且结局指标仅关注膝关节活动度和粗大运动功能，外推至其他年龄组或更广泛功能仍需进一步研究。
items.limitationEn: The study was limited to 4-6 year old children with hemiplegic cerebral palsy, and outcome measures focused only on knee ROM and gross motor function, thus generalization to other age groups or broader functions requires further research.

items.title: Calendar Year (CY) 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule Final Rule
items.summary: CMS issued the Calendar Year (CY) 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule final rule, effective Jan. 1, 2027, finalizing a projected decrease in the qualifying APM conversion factor by $0.62 (-1.83%) to $32.95 and the non-qualifying APM conversion factor by $0.77 (-2.31%) to $32.63, driven by a statutory -2.50% reduction from CY 2026.
items.curatedReason: CMS 发布的 2027 年医师收费标准最终规则，明确了 Medicare 物理治疗师的报销费率将继续面临整体下降（QP 下降 1.83%，非 QP 下降 2.31%）。物理治疗执业者必须审视并调整运营模式，以应对这些持续的财务压力。
items.titleZh: 2027 日历年（CY）Medicare 医师收费标准最终规则
items.summaryZh: CMS 发布了2027日历年（CY）Medicare医师收费标准最终规则，自2027年1月1日起生效，最终确定合格APM转换系数预计将减少0.62美元（-1.83%）至32.95美元，非合格APM转换系数将减少0.77美元（-2.31%）至32.63美元，主要原因是法定从2026日历年减少2.50%。
items.curatedReasonEn: The CMS CY 2027 Physician Fee Schedule final rule clarifies that Medicare reimbursement rates for physical therapists will continue to face overall decreases (1.83% for QPs, 2.31% for non-QPs). Physical therapy practitioners must review and adjust their operational models to address these ongoing financial pressures.

items.title: Investigating the Feasibility of Locomotor Training for Children Under 5 Years With Complex Neurodisabilties.
items.summary: A 6-week locomotor training program, including partial body weight-supported treadmill training and overground walking in supported stepping devices, was found feasible and beneficial for 71 children (mean age 2.8 years) with neurodisabilities, showing improvements in Goal Attainment Scaling scores (12.8 to 56.2), Canadian Occupational Performance Measure, and mobility outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对神经功能障碍儿童的训练研究进一步支持了负重支持式跑台训练和辅助踏步设备在改善运动功能方面的可行性和益处。在儿科康复中，可考虑将此类步态训练纳入早期干预方案。
items.titleZh: 探讨负重支持式跑台训练对5岁以下复杂神经功能障碍儿童的可行性
items.summaryZh: 一项为期6周的负重支持式跑台训练结合辅助踏步设备的步态训练项目，对71名平均年龄2.8岁的神经功能障碍儿童显示出可行性和益处，目标达成量表分数从12.8提高到56.2，加拿大职业表现量表和运动能力测量结果均有改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This training study for children with neurodisabilities further supports the feasibility and benefits of partial body weight-supported treadmill training and supported stepping devices in improving motor function. In pediatric rehabilitation, such locomotor training can be considered for early intervention programs.
items.limitation: 该研究为单组前瞻性研究，缺乏对照组，无法排除自然病程的影响，且随访时间较短。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-group pre-post study without a control group, limiting the ability to rule out the influence of natural progression, and the follow-up duration was short.
items.journal: Pediatric physical therapy : the official publication of the Section on Pediatrics of the American Physical Therapy Association

items.title: Development and psychometric evaluation of the Severity of Myalgic Encephalomyelitis Scale (SoMES) and the Myalgic Encephalomyelitis Occupational Status Scale (MEOSS)
items.summary: The Severity of Myalgic Encephalomyelitis Scale (SoMES) and the Myalgic Encephalomyelitis Occupational Status Scale (MEOSS) were developed and found to be valid, reliable, and sensitive assessments of disease severity and occupational status in 995 adults with ME/CFS, demonstrating moderate-good criterion-related validity (SoMES r=0.663, MEOSS r=0.472) and excellent test-retest reliability for MEOSS (k=0.76).
items.curatedReason: 新量表 SoMES 和 MEOSS 为肌痛性脑脊髓炎/慢性疲劳综合征的疾病严重程度和职业状态评估提供了有效、可靠且敏感的工具，有助于临床医生更客观地跟踪患者的疾病进展和康复需求。
items.titleZh: 肌痛性脑脊髓炎严重程度量表（SoMES）和肌痛性脑脊髓炎职业状态量表（MEOSS）的开发与心理测量学评估
items.summaryZh: 肌痛性脑脊髓炎严重程度量表（SoMES）和肌痛性脑脊髓炎职业状态量表（MEOSS）已开发完成，并在995名肌痛性脑脊髓炎/慢性疲劳综合征成人患者中被证实为疾病严重程度和职业状态的有效、可靠且敏感的评估工具，显示出中度至良好的效标关联效度（SoMES r=0.663, MEOSS r=0.472）和MEOSS优秀的重测信度（k=0.76）。
items.curatedReasonEn: The new SoMES and MEOSS scales provide valid, reliable, and sensitive tools for assessing disease severity and occupational status in Myalgic Encephalomyelitis/Chronic Fatigue Syndrome, helping clinicians objectively track patient progression and rehabilitation needs.
items.limitation: 这是一项初步的横断面心理测量学研究，需要通过更多前瞻性研究来验证其在不同人群和长期随访中的表现。
items.limitationEn: This is a preliminary cross-sectional psychometric study, requiring further prospective research to validate its performance in diverse populations and long-term follow-up.

items.title:
The first Archives of Physiotherapy Best Paper Awards: recognizing research that advances the profession
							| Archives of Physiotherapy
items.summary: Archives of Physiotherapy announced its first Best Paper Awards, recognizing an original research article on physiotherapy dose and motor recovery in early subacute stroke, and a systematic review on resistance training with external loads for chronic low back pain, highlighting methodologically rigorous and profession-relevant research.
items.curatedReason: 这项行业奖项不仅展示了物理治疗领域在卒中康复和慢性腰痛管理方面的高质量研究，也强调了循证实践的重要性。它提示了精准剂量的卒中康复对运动恢复的具体作用，以及负重训练在慢性腰痛中并非总能带来优越的临床益处。
items.titleZh: 首届《物理治疗档案》最佳论文奖：表彰推动专业发展的研究
items.summaryZh: 《物理治疗档案》公布了首届最佳论文奖，表彰了一篇关于亚急性卒中早期物理治疗剂量与运动恢复的原创研究，以及一篇关于负重抗阻训练治疗慢性腰痛的系统综述，旨在突出方法严谨且与专业相关的研究。
items.curatedReasonEn: This industry award not only showcases high-quality research in stroke rehabilitation and chronic low back pain management within physical therapy, but also emphasizes the importance of evidence-based practice. It highlights the specific role of precise dosage in stroke rehabilitation for motor recovery, and that loaded exercise doesn't always provide superior clinical benefits in chronic low back pain.

items.title: Neurological and functional recovery despite persistent skull defect after decompressive hemicraniectomy: a case report.
items.summary: A 60-year-old man with a persistent skull defect after decompressive hemicraniectomy for malignant cerebral infarction showed neurological and functional improvements beyond 6 months post-stroke, including increased Glasgow Coma Scale, Hasegawa's Dementia Scale-Revised, and Behavioral Inattention Test scores, alongside reduced Scale for Contraversive Pushing scores.
items.curatedReason: 本病例报告提示，尽管存在持续性颅骨缺损，患者在卒中后仍能实现显著的神经功能和运动功能恢复。这鼓励临床医生在评估这类患者的康复潜力时，超越解剖学限制，专注于功能适应和个体化干预。
items.titleZh: 去骨瓣减压术后持续颅骨缺损患者的神经和功能恢复：一例病例报告
items.summaryZh: 一名60岁男性患者在恶性脑梗死去骨瓣减压术后，尽管颅骨持续缺损，但在卒中后6个月内仍显示出神经和功能改善，包括格拉斯哥昏迷评分、长谷川痴呆量表修订版和行为忽视测试分数提高，以及对抗性推障碍量表分数降低。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case report suggests that significant neurological and functional recovery can occur despite a persistent skull defect after stroke. Clinicians should be encouraged to look beyond anatomical limitations and focus on functional adaptation and individualized interventions when assessing rehabilitation potential in such patients.
items.limitation: 本研究为单病例报告，结论的外推性非常有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a single case report, and the generalizability of its findings is very limited.

items.title: Effects of Exercise Type and Duration on Pain, Function, and Quality of Life in Patients With Knee Osteoarthritis: A Systematic Review With Bayesian Network Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A Bayesian network meta-analysis of 35 trials (n=3808) found that short-term (≤12 weeks) combined aerobic and resistance exercise had the largest effects on pain (SMD = -0.937, low certainty), function (SMD = -0.590, low certainty), and quality of life (SMD = 0.663, low certainty) in patients with knee osteoarthritis.
items.curatedReason: 膝骨关节炎患者的运动干预策略现在有了更明确的排序。短期（≤12 周）联合有氧和阻力训练在疼痛、功能和生活质量改善方面均显示出最大效应，这支持你在制定初期康复计划时优先考虑这种综合性方案。
items.titleZh: 运动类型和持续时间对膝骨关节炎患者疼痛、功能和生活质量的影响：一项贝叶斯网络 Meta 分析系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 35 项试验（n=3808）的贝叶斯网络 Meta 分析发现，短期（≤12 周）联合有氧和阻力训练对膝骨关节炎患者的疼痛（SMD = -0.937, 低确定性）、功能（SMD = -0.590, 低确定性）和生活质量（SMD = 0.663, 低确定性）改善具有最大的效应。
items.curatedReasonEn: Exercise intervention strategies for knee OA patients now have a clearer ranking. Short-term (≤12 weeks) combined aerobic and resistance exercise shows the largest effects across pain, function, and quality of life improvements. This supports prioritizing such combined approaches in your initial rehabilitation planning.
items.limitation: 长期（>12 周）运动干预的临床意义证据仍然有限，主要结论集中于短期效果。
items.limitationEn: Evidence regarding the clinical significance of long-term (>12 weeks) exercise interventions remains limited, with primary conclusions focused on short-term effects.

items.title: The Role of Artificial Intelligence in Treatment Planning in Physical and Rehabilitation Medicine: A Systematic Review.
items.summary: A systematic review of 9 studies found that large language models (LLMs) showed promising capabilities in supporting rehabilitation treatment planning, with concordance up to 98.75% with expert opinion after review, and alignment with guidelines in musculoskeletal and cardiovascular rehabilitation. However, hallucinations were reported, underscoring the necessity of supervision.
items.curatedReason: LLM 在康复治疗计划中表现出高达 98.75% 的专家意见吻合度，且在肌骨和心血管康复中与指南高度一致。但是，它们偶尔会出现“幻觉”，所以你若考虑在临床中使用，务必保持监督，不能完全放手。
items.titleZh: 人工智能在物理和康复医学治疗计划中的作用：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 9 项研究的系统综述发现，大型语言模型（LLMs）在康复治疗计划中显示出良好潜力，经专家审查后与专家意见吻合度高达 98.75%，并在肌骨和心血管康复中与指南保持一致。然而，研究也报告了模型“幻觉”，强调了监督的必要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: LLMs show promise in rehab treatment planning, with up to 98.75% concordance with expert opinion and high alignment with guidelines in musculoskeletal and cardiovascular rehab. However, given reported “hallucinations,” if you're considering their clinical use, expert supervision is non-negotiable.
items.limitation: 纳入研究数量较少（9 项），且证据质量有待提升，限制了对实际效果和实施策略的最终判断。
items.limitationEn: The limited number of included studies (9) and varying evidence quality restrict definitive conclusions on real-world effectiveness and implementation strategies.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Effectiveness of Plyometric Exercises Versus Flatfoot Corrective Exercises on Balance and Foot Posture in Obese Children with a Flexible Flatfoot: A Comparative Study
items.summary: A non-randomized comparative study (n=120) found that 8 weeks of plyometric training significantly improved balance (median path length: 30.39 cm vs. 37.45 cm, p<0.001) and foot posture (left foot, p=0.028) compared to flatfoot corrective exercises in obese children with flexible flatfoot.
items.curatedReason: 对于肥胖儿童的柔韧性扁平足，弹跳训练在改善平衡方面显示出优于传统矫正训练的效果，并在左脚足部姿势上略有优势。这提示你可以将弹跳训练纳入针对该人群的儿科物理治疗方案。
items.titleZh: 弹跳训练与扁平足矫正训练对肥胖儿童柔韧性扁平足平衡和足部姿势的影响：一项比较研究
items.summaryZh: 一项非随机比较研究（n=120）发现，在肥胖且患有柔韧性扁平足的儿童中，8 周的弹跳训练相比扁平足矫正训练，显著改善了平衡（中位路径长度：30.39 厘米 vs. 37.45 厘米, p<0.001），并在左脚足部姿势上略有优势（p=0.028）。
items.curatedReasonEn: For obese children with flexible flatfoot, plyometric training showed superior effectiveness in improving balance and a slight advantage in left foot posture compared to traditional corrective exercises. This suggests you can incorporate plyometric training into pediatric physiotherapy programs for this population.
items.limitation: 本研究为非随机对照设计，可能存在选择偏倚，且随访时间较短（8 周）。
items.limitationEn: This study used a non-randomized controlled design, which may introduce selection bias, and had a relatively short follow-up period (8 weeks).

items.title: A Retrospective Real-World Assessment of Motor Status After Stroke Using a Home-Based Brain-Computer Interface
items.summary: A retrospective observational study (n=452) of stroke survivors using home-based BCI therapy found mean UEFM improved by 4.3 points (95% CI, 3.7-4.9; P<0.001) at week 12, reaching MCID (5.6 points) by week 16, and continued to improve to 8.1 points by week 52.
items.curatedReason: 这项回顾性研究显示，脑机接口（BCI）家庭治疗在卒中后上肢严重功能障碍患者中实现了运动状态改善，并在 16 周达到临床最小重要差异（MCID）。这为 BCI 在院外康复中的应用提供了真实世界证据，尤其对那些重度慢性障碍患者。
items.titleZh: 基于家庭脑机接口对卒中后运动状态的回顾性真实世界评估
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性观察研究（n=452）评估了卒中幸存者在家使用脑机接口（BCI）治疗的效果，发现在第 12 周，平均 UEFM 评分改善了 4.3 分（95% CI, 3.7-4.9; P<0.001），在第 16 周达到临床最小重要差异（5.6 分），并在第 52 周持续改善至 8.1 分。
items.curatedReasonEn: This retrospective study shows that home-based Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) therapy improved motor status in stroke survivors with severe upper extremity impairment, reaching the minimal clinically important difference (MCID) by 16 weeks. This provides real-world evidence for BCI application in outpatient rehabilitation, especially for those with severe chronic deficits.
items.limitation: 作为回顾性观察研究，其结果容易受到选择偏倚和混杂因素的影响，需要随机对照试验进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: As a retrospective observational study, its results are susceptible to selection bias and confounding factors, requiring further validation through randomized controlled trials.

items.title: CMS Final Rule Strengthens Supports Lasting Drug Savings
items.summary: CMS has released a final rule to strengthen and support lasting drug savings, focusing on the Medicare Drug Price Negotiation Program and the Medicare Prescription Drug Benefit Program.
items.curatedReason: CMS 发布了旨在巩固药物定价谈判和处方药福利计划的最终规则。这对 PT 报销和执业没有直接影响，但作为美国医疗系统关键部分的成本控制机制，值得你关注宏观背景。不过这并非 PT 执业的直接变化点。
items.titleZh: CMS 最终规则加强并支持持久的药物节约
